content: It would be easier to answer your question if you showed us a screen shot of how it looks now, but the general solution is to click on the "Message List Display Options" icon to the right and choose "Sort by..." whatever criteria you want, in this case probably Date, Descending, Unthreaded. You can also get to these options from the main menu <View | Sort By...>. If the menu bar is hidden, press <Alt> or <F10> to reveal it.

content: This sounds like a bug in the notification sound settings. If both the “Play” and “Browse” buttons are unresponsive and the existing sound link also fails, it may be a UI issue rather than a configuration problem. Hopefully, the developers can reproduce it and provide a fix so users can select and preview custom notification sounds again.

Per poter inquadrare il problema prova a fornire queste informazioni:

  1. Versione di Thunderbird
  2. Versione del sistema operativo
  3. Provider delle caselle email (Gmail, Libero, Hotmail, etc.)
  4. Tipologia di account (POP3, IMAP)
  5. Estensioni installate
  6. Messaggi di errore che vengono visualizzati durante l'utilizzo di Thunderbird
  7. Software di sicurezza eventualmente presenti (Antivirus e simili)
  8. Screenshot del problema (se utile a chiarire il contesto)
